meta.title: Francisco Marinho - Senior Frontend Developer
meta.description: Portfolio of Francisco Marinho, Senior Frontend Developer specialized in React, Next.js and TypeScript with 5+ years of experience.

hero.name: Francisco Marinho
hero.tagline: Senior frontend developer. I think of interfaces as pieces that fit together: I started out programming robotic arms with blocks during my master's, and today I build products on a design system at HostGator.

about.label: About
about.title: Software engineer with a master's in informatics, building frontends for over 5 years.
about.lead: I hold a degree in Software Engineering and a master's in Informatics from UFAM, with research in educational robotics published at SBIE 2022 and SBESC 2020.
about.bio_1: Today I'm a senior frontend developer at HostGator, on the monetization, innovation and AI agents teams. Before that, I worked at O2 Filmes, Atem and Sidia, where I built design systems, micro-frontends and products in React and TypeScript.
about.bio_2: I also created and maintain CurrículoRaiz, a résumé SaaS that I develop end to end.

projects.label: Projects
projects.title: What I've built
projects.subtitle: Products in production, from HostGator's shopping cart to a script editor used by professional screenwriters.

curriculoraiz.title: CurrículoRaiz
curriculoraiz.description: A SaaS for building résumés, with 9 templates, PDF and Word export and import from a LinkedIn PDF.
curriculoraiz.did: The whole product, from screen to PDF: an editor in React with TypeScript, TanStack Query and Tiptap, and a Node.js API with Express and Prisma that generates PDF with Puppeteer and Word with docx, with Google sign-in and Mercado Pago payments.
curriculoraiz.image_alt: CurrículoRaiz home page, with the headline "Um currículo com a sua cara" next to a résumé template

hostgator-dashboard.title: HostGator customer dashboard
hostgator-dashboard.description: A dashboard where customers track metrics, manage hosting services and request support.
hostgator-dashboard.did: Interfaces in React with Redux Saga, design system components and tests with Jest and React Testing Library.
hostgator-dashboard.image_alt: HostGator customer dashboard, with the assistant search and service shortcuts

teksto.title: Screenwriting platform
teksto.description: A SaaS platform for screenwriters, with scalable React and TypeScript components, Redux and Saga flows and REST and GraphQL integration.

hostgator-cart.title: Shopping cart
hostgator-cart.description: A cart module for buying hosting products and services, focused on conversion and a smooth checkout.

mbx-academy.title: MBX Academy LMS
mbx-academy.description: A learning management system for corporate education that delivers and manages classes, events, assessments and reports.

atem-portal.title: Customer portal
atem-portal.description: Atem's customer portal, with invoices, order history and authentication through AWS.

uprobotics.title: UpRobotics
uprobotics.description: A web tool for visually programming robotic arms with Google Blockly, generating code for Arduino UNO or 3D simulations in Webots.
